title: Positive-event bound for centered functions
statement: Let $g$ be a real-valued function on the Boolean cube of dimension $n$ with uniform mean zero. Then $(\mathbb E|g|)^2\leq4\langle g,g\rangle\Pr[g>0]$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function g on the Boolean cube of dimension n
Uniform expectation of g equals zero
replaced: Let $g:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ have uniform mean zero. Then $(\E|g|)^2\le4\E[g^2]\Pr[g>0]$.
